subject.text: Someone called asking for my password

description.text: This morning a caller said he was from the IT Workshop. He said my account had a problem and he needed my password to fix it.
I refused and hung up right away. I did not give my password.
My computer is running normally as usual.
Did I do the right thing? What should I do if he calls again?

history.text: Last week: PC-0207 passed the routine check, antivirus active.

explanation: A real technician never asks for a password, so Wulan was right to refuse and nothing leaked. Guide Wulan to always refuse password requests and report similar calls to the IT Workshop.
hints: Did anything actually leak? Look at what Wulan did after the call.
The password was not given and the computer is normal, so Wulan needs guidance, not a repair.
